supports.question: Does the edited image visibly show a frog placed inside the toilet bowl?
supports.criteria: Pass if a frog is clearly visible within the toilet bowl; fail if the image clearly shows no frog inside the bowl; unknown if the bowl or its contents are obscured or the evidence is otherwise insufficient to determine this.
supports.binding: The frog must be inside the toilet bowl of the toilet in the input image.

supports.question: Does the edited image show any progress toward placing a frog inside the toilet bowl, even if the frog is not yet visibly inside it?
supports.criteria: Pass if visible evidence shows a partial attempt toward placing a frog inside the bowl, such as a frog partly entering it; fail if there is clearly no such progress; unknown if the evidence is insufficient to distinguish progress from no progress. A frog clearly inside the bowl is complete, not partial progress.
supports.binding: Count only progress toward placing a frog inside the toilet bowl; unrelated edits do not count.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Apply the original rubric to the requested change only. Return yes when the frog is visibly placed inside the toilet bowl. Return no only when evidence establishes that no requested change has progressed. Return partial when evidence establishes some progress toward placing the frog inside the bowl but does not establish completion. Return unknown when the evidence cannot distinguish among these outcomes. A skipped support is unobserved, not a failure or not-applicable finding: if the completion check passes, that establishes yes without needing the partial-progress check; if completion fails, the progress check is needed to distinguish partial from no. Supporting observations earn no completion credit independently, and unrelated edits do not count.
